name: The Adjective Ladder
markdown:
#### The Adjective Ladder In _Fate Condensed_, and Fate in general, all ratings are organized into a ladder of adjectives, shown here.
Rating Adjective
+8 Legendary
+7 Epic
+6 Fantastic
+5 Superb
+4 Great
+3 Good
+2 Fair
+1 Average
+0 Mediocre
-1 Poor
-2 Terrible
-3 Catastrophic
-4 Horrifying
